fabric--noun.def: Cloth, or the basic structure of something.

pension--noun.def: Money paid regularly to someone who has retired.

developing--adj.def: Growing towards a more advanced state.

addict--noun.def: A person who cannot stop using something harmful.

feature--verb.def: To include someone or something as an important part.
feature--verb.ex: The film features two young actors.
feature--verb.exTr: Film iki genç oyuncuya yer veriyor.

cope--verb.def: To deal successfully with a difficult situation.

peg--noun.def: A short pin used to hang things or fix them.
peg--noun.ex: Hang your coat on the peg.

tumor--noun.def: A mass of cells growing abnormally in the body.

ignorant--adj.def: Knowing very little, or not aware of something.
ignorant--adj.ex: We were ignorant of the rule.

modest--adj.def: Not boastful, or not large in amount.

whisper--verb.def: To speak very quietly so others cannot hear.

grain--noun.def: Seeds of food crops, or a single tiny piece.

essentially--adv.def: In the most basic way, ignoring small details.
essentially--adv.ex: The two plans are essentially the same.

subtle--adj.def: Not obvious, and needing attention to notice.

explosive--adj.def: Able to explode, or likely to cause anger.

x-ray--noun.def: A photograph of the inside of the body.

superintendent--noun.def: A senior police officer or a manager of a building.

corruption--noun.def: Dishonest behaviour by people in power.

rival--noun.def: A person or company competing with another.

purchase--noun.def: Something bought, or the act of buying.
purchase--noun.ex: Keep the receipt for your purchase.

purchase--verb.def: To buy something, in formal English.
purchase--verb.ex: They purchased the land last year.

elite--noun.def: The most powerful or skilled group in a society.
elite--noun.ex: A small elite owns the land.

submit--verb.def: To give a document to an authority for a decision.

supervisor--noun.def: A person who watches over the work of others.

resident--noun.def: A person who lives in a particular place.

stew--noun.def: A dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid.

distract--verb.def: To take someone's attention away from what they are doing.

spark--noun.def: A tiny piece of burning material, or a small flash of electricity.

peak--noun.def: The top of a mountain, or the highest point of something.
peak--noun.ex: Demand reaches its peak in July.

fierce--adj.def: Violent and angry, or very strong.
fierce--adj.ex: A fierce wind shook the trees.

radical--noun.def: A person who wants complete political change.
radical--noun.ex: He was a radical in his youth.

breed--noun.def: A particular type of animal within a species.
breed--noun.ex: This breed of dog is calm.

adore--verb.def: To love someone or something very much.

execute--verb.def: To kill someone as a legal punishment, or to carry out a plan.

dose--noun.ex: Do not exceed the daily dose.

instantly--adv.def: Immediately, with no delay at all.

bolt--noun.def: A metal pin used with a nut, or a bar that locks a door.

bolt--verb.def: To lock with a bolt, or to run away suddenly.

sharply--adv.def: Suddenly and by a large amount, or in an angry tone.

assembly--noun.def: A group meeting for a purpose, or the act of putting parts together.
assembly--noun.ex: The school holds an assembly daily.

ling--noun.def: A long sea fish of the cod family.

anchor--noun.def: A heavy metal object that keeps a ship in place.
anchor--noun.ex: They dropped anchor in the bay.

interior--noun.def: The inside part of a building or a vehicle.

urge--verb.def: To strongly advise someone to do something.
urge--verb.ex: Doctors urge people to walk more.
urge--verb.exTr: Doktorlar insanları daha çok yürümeye teşvik ediyor.

strain--verb.def: To injure by stretching, or to separate liquid from solids.
strain--verb.ex: He strained his back lifting boxes.

compassion--noun.def: Sympathy for people who are suffering.

obsession--noun.def: Something you think about far too much.

ridge--noun.def: A long narrow high part of a hill or a roof.

intent--adj.def: Determined to do something, or concentrating hard.

bark--verb.def: To make the short loud sound a dog makes.
bark--verb.ex: The dog barked at the postman.

rack--noun.def: A frame with bars for holding things.
rack--noun.ex: Put the plates on the rack.

decade--noun.ex: The town changed in a decade.

pine--noun.def: A tall evergreen tree with needles and cones.

finance--noun.def: The management of large amounts of money.

altar--noun.def: A table used for religious ceremonies.

thrill--noun.def: A sudden strong feeling of excitement.
thrill--noun.ex: The ride gave her a thrill.

zip--noun.def: A fastener with two rows of teeth that lock together.
zip--noun.ex: The zip on my bag broke.

dimension--noun.def: A measurement such as length or width, or an aspect of something.

rug--noun.def: A thick piece of cloth used to cover part of a floor.
rug--noun.ex: A woollen rug lay by the door.
rug--noun.exTr: Kapının yanında yünlü bir kilim vardı.

jaw--noun.def: Either of the two bones that hold your teeth.
jaw--noun.ex: He broke his jaw playing football.

mortgage--noun.def: A long loan used to buy a house.

demanding--adj.def: Needing a lot of time, effort or skill.

slaughter--noun.def: The killing of many people, or the killing of animals for meat.

legendary--adj.def: Very famous and admired for a long time.

burial--noun.def: The act of putting a dead body in the ground.
burial--noun.ex: The burial took place at dawn.

vow--noun.def: A serious promise, especially at a wedding.
vow--noun.ex: They exchanged vows in the garden.

breakdown--noun.def: A failure of a machine, a system or a person's health.

swan--noun.def: A large white water bird with a long neck.
swan--noun.ex: A swan glided across the lake.

moonlight--noun.def: The light that comes from the moon.

identification--noun.def: Proof of who you are, or the act of recognizing something.

loneliness--noun.def: The unhappy feeling of being alone.
loneliness--noun.ex: Loneliness is common in old age.

duel--noun.def: A formal fight between two people with weapons.
duel--noun.ex: The story ends with a duel.

consult--verb.def: To ask an expert for advice or information.
